title: Relative Counterfactual Contrastive Learning for Mitigating Pretrained Stance Bias in Stance Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Using a Structural Causal Model (SCM) to capture the bias as the direct causal effect of pretrained language models on stance prediction, and evaluating mitigation performance on stance detection benchmarks (SemEval-2016, UKP, and VAST) using relative counterfactual contrastive learning.
